title: Tip Variance by Day of Week
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), cashback events (`cashback:event`), price tracker alerts (`pricetrack:alert`), and tip logs (`tiplog:shift`).
app: Micro-finance telemetry for latte-factor spending, cashback apps, price tracking, and tip logging sent to Splunk HEC via finance exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tiplog:shift
| search tips_amount=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(tips_amount) as avg_tips_amount max(tips_amount) as max_tips_amount by _time weekday
| sort - _time
description: Tracks tips by day of week over time and breaks it out by weekday.
value: Day-of-week variance helps with staffing expectations, cash planning, and whether weekends are truly carrying the month.
implementation: Send tips by day of week events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of tips by day of week by weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how tips by day of week changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
